subject.title: [Security] Mitigating timing attacks in GitHub Auth OAuth callback validation

question: Does a security owner confirm that the reported GitHub callback surface is absent and close this report, or request a corrected private advisory identifying another reachable OAuth path?
rationale: The current GitHub Copilot implementation contradicts the reported source and flow, but protected security reports require human disposition and any corrected exploit details should not be developed publicly.

options.title: Close the unsupported claim
options.body: Close after confirming the GitHub Copilot device flow has no callback state comparison and invite a new private advisory only with an exact current path and reproducible impact.

options.title: Request corrected private evidence
options.body: Keep the report temporarily open while asking the reporter to identify the actual current file, function, tested revision, network path, timing measurements, and boundary impact through a private advisory.
